currentRoundInspection.scope: Four actually inspected exterior pictures and standard viewer PMTiles/DEM only. No bespoke surveys or redistributed photographs.

pictures.author: InfernoXV
pictures.observed: Inspected enlarged oblique courtyard exterior: long grey-brick nave, round upper oculi between vertical wall pilasters, stacked broad cornices and a balustraded/attic roof edge. Baroque front has pilasters, round medallion, curving shoulders and high central cross. A pale ribbed dome/drum rises at the far end. Trees obscure much of the lower wall and front; those and courtyard buildings are excluded.

pictures.author: Peter Potrowl
pictures.observed: Inspected enlarged wide winter side view: long low grey roof and repeated round windows/pilasters, taller northern rear block with short upper lights, pale octagonal drum/ribbed dome and cross, and the tall thin curving Baroque entrance screen at the other end. Snow, boundary wall, urban traffic/buildings, trees and wires are context and not modeled. Hidden rear/roof joins remain estimates.

pictures.author: InfernoXV
pictures.observed: Inspected street-side upper facade: central cross over a small flared crown, circular emblem, paired pilasters/stacked capitals, curving shoulders, large curled volutes and horizontal cornices. Street trees/utility wires and foreground wall obscure the base. The standard PMTiles road lies to the church south, supporting south-facing main facade.

pictures.author: 用心阁
pictures.observed: Inspected complete narrow front elevation: broad lower block, central upper arched light/doorway axis, paired pilasters, large curled shoulder volutes, central coat-of-arms/round emblem, curved upper gable/crown and cross. Small side pedestals/caps; red-brown entrance glimpsed behind trees/foreground shrine, traffic and buses. Decorative relief/lettering and hidden doors remain simplified estimates.
